name: What are some popular home renovation trends homeowners are choosing in the Boise area?

mainEntity.name: What are some popular home renovation trends homeowners are choosing in the Boise area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners in the Boise area are increasingly opting for renovations that enhance both functionality and aesthetic appeal. Popular trends include open-concept living spaces, energy-efficient upgrades, and integrating smart home technology. Additionally, there's a strong focus on creating versatile outdoor living areas, and kitchens and bathrooms that feature durable, low-maintenance materials. Considering these trends can help inform your decisions, balancing modern appeal with long-term value for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular renovation trends in Boise include open concepts, energy efficiency, smart home tech, and improved outdoor living spaces.
